purpose: Exact human rights decisions for every BSB and external-source component that a curation job may send to an approved AI provider or retain in derived draft form — per Task 18A, Gate D2

artifact.note: BSB bundled slice 4.7MB, 66 books — Neh.2.1-20 excerpts only for curation jobs

component.fieldSelector: verse_text only, no notes, no introductions
component.licenseSpdx: BSB — public berean.bible distribution terms (owner-confirmed 2026-09-12 per CONTENT_RIGHTS.md)

provider.note: Provider/model to be selected by owner at Gate D2 — this packet requests authorization for external_ai_processing with retention/training constraints below

retention.providerRetention: 30 days, no training on input, no retention of output beyond provider's transient processing per provider terms — owner to confirm at Gate D2
retention.training: prohibited — provider must not use BSB excerpts to train models
retention.promptRetention: prompt (with excerpts) retained in private quarantine only for audit, not in provider logs beyond 30 days
retention.outputRetention: draft output retained in private quarantine as draft candidate only, not published, with lineage to BSB excerpt digest
retention.draftDerivativeStorage: private quarantine + private_staging draft tables only, not public, not embedded, not shared

bsb.attribution: BSB attribution required in draft lineage, not in prompt to provider beyond excerpt itself

externalSources.fieldSelector: 6 structured fields only, no Claude descriptions, no geodata
externalSources.excerptLimit: Neh.2-relevant persons/places only (5 entities for Neh.2 slice)
Neh2 persons only (Nehemiah, Artaxerxes, Hanani) for discrepancy context

scholarlyCorpus.note: No scholarly evidence corpus approved at this time per Gate D2 packet. Per Task 18A instructions: if none is approved, later context jobs (20F) are limited to direct Scripture observations and must emit open questions for When, Before, Stakes, biographies, and historical/interpretive explanations not supported by allowed input.
scholarlyCorpus.implicationFor19A: Bundle assembler must enforce machine-readable restriction: context claim kinds When/Before/Stakes/biography/historical background/interpretation are null/open_questions unless scholarly corpus is later approved via separate Gate D2 amendment
scholarlyCorpus.proposedCorpusForFuture: Peer-reviewed biblical reference works, reputable atlases, primary historical sources with scholarly framing — to be proposed in separate packet after 18A

operationsMatrix.evaluation_import: allowed for all 5 sources + BSB excerpts (for staging)
operationsMatrix.drafting: allowed for all 5 sources + BSB excerpts (for AI drafting per 20A-G, but only after Gate D2)
operationsMatrix.publication: denied for all — no AI output may be published without human review (Gate E1)
operationsMatrix.external_ai_processing: candidate — requires Gate D2 per-component approval (this packet)
operationsMatrix.embedding: denied for all — no embeddings until separate approval
